caveats: Validation only and exploratory: not pre-specified, and the GBM grid points were chosen on val.

v-bins select on label realizations (v is computed from the stored label estimates J and J_belief), so the argument that hindsight-scored differences are unbiased does not carry over to them; it does carry over to the a-bins, which use the posterior only.
v uses the label estimates in place of the expected costs, so it overstates the between-cause term by pi (1 - pi) Var(J - J_twin) on average.
In the zero bin of v the two label sets are (up to decisions with 1 - pi < 1e-12) identical, so E1 there comes from training only (spillover).
first_actions describes the first action only; what the follow-up policy does with the backup channel afterwards is not measured here.

definitions.E1: per decision, regret of the flat GBM trained on the train split's belief labels (J_belief) minus regret of the flat GBM trained on its hindsight labels (J); each GBM's FLAT_GRID point is chosen on val regret under its own label set (train_direct.flat_predictions); negative favours belief labels
definitions.E1 intervals: point, 95% percentile interval and two-sided bootstrap p (cpsdefense.eval.metrics.paired_cluster_bootstrap_diff): per subset, a paired bootstrap over the subset's episodes, seed 0
definitions.E1_given_differ: mean E1 over the decisions where the two GBMs choose different candidates (E1 is 0 where they choose the same one)
definitions.TOL: 1e-09: values closer than this count as equal (scripts/dataset_stats.py TOL)
definitions.a: pi (1 - pi) per decision (0 where pi is not finite)
definitions.ambiguous family: dec_family: the episode's incident is a link or remote I/O module fault of one sensor group (the paper's ambiguous family); view 'family'
definitions.bins: zero: score <= TOL; T1-T3: terciles of the score over the decisions with score > TOL (np.quantile at 1/3 and 2/3; a value equal to a cut point goes to the upper bin). v_bins: the set's own cut points; v_bins_reference_cuts: the cut points of the reference set (--cuts-from)
definitions.contrasts: E1 on one subset minus E1 on another (no_backup_minus_backup, top_minus_zero), paired_cluster_bootstrap_diff of the subset means on joint resamples of all val episodes, seed 1
definitions.differ_share: share of decisions where the two GBMs choose different candidates
definitions.gather_optimal_belief_share: share of decisions with both observe and non-observe candidates in which the best observe candidate's J_belief is below the best non-observe candidate's by more than TOL (scripts/dataset_stats.py, gather_belief)
definitions.gbm_belief / gbm_hindsight: the flat GBM trained on belief / hindsight labels
definitions.gbm_switch_share: share of decisions where the GBM chooses a switch_to_backup action
definitions.high_stakes_share: share of decisions whose candidates' hindsight trip probabilities differ by more than TOL (scripts/dataset_stats.py, the paper's high-stakes decisions); high_stakes_belief_share: the same on p_trip_belief
definitions.pi: dec_posterior, the posterior of the true cause given the defender's evidence (1 outside the family and where the twin was excluded)
definitions.regret: J of the chosen candidate minus the lowest J among the decision's candidates, with J from the scoring label set (belief_scoring: J_belief; hindsight_scoring: J)
definitions.switch_belief_optimal_share: the candidate with the lowest J_belief (the first on exact ties) is a switch_to_backup action; switch_belief_co_optimal_share: some switch_to_backup candidate is within TOL of the lowest J_belief
definitions.v: between-cause term per decision: mean over the decision's candidates of pi (1 - pi) (J - J_twin)^2, J_twin = (J_belief - pi J) / (1 - pi) (belief_sensitivity.twin_labels); 0 where 1 - pi < 1e-12; uses the stored label estimates
definitions.v_above_median: v above the median of v over the reference set's val decisions with v > TOL
